title: Understanding the Federal Government's Debt Purchase in Desenrola 3.0
seoTitle: How the Federal Debt Purchase Works in Desenrola
subtitle: The new phase of the program brings important changes for debtors
excerpt: The third phase of the Desenrola program, created by provisional measure, alters how individual debts are negotiated.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Created this Friday (25) by provisional measure, the third phase of the individual debt renegotiation program, known as Desenrola 3.0, brings an important change compared to previous stages.

The new phase of the program has the federal government's purchase of debts as its main objective, offering a new negotiation alternative for debtors.

This change represents a significant adjustment in payment conditions, setting it apart from earlier phases of the renegotiation program.

With information from Agência Brasil.
